examples.name: Lake compiled-configuration ownership

older.behavior: compiled Lean package configuration is stored under the package/dependency .lake/config tree

newer.behavior: compiled configuration is stored under the workspace .lake/config/<package-index> tree

change.title: feat: lake: hoist compiled configurations (#13683)
change.consequence: cross-workspace compiled-configuration ownership/contention changes; broader package-local mutation does not disappear

examples.lesson: A nearby release can change the exact persistence and concurrency boundary that a verification/build-system claim depends on.

examples.name: Charon same-version revisions with different Rust pins

newer.selection: Charon repository-local nightly-2026.06.03 tag resolved by Anneal Cargo.lock

examples.lesson: Matching semantic versions and matching date-like release labels do not establish identical source or transitive toolchain requirements.

reuse_rule: Use adjacency to choose a comparison, not to substitute old evidence for the new exact identity. Revalidate the proposition's supporting decision points and use a differential execution probe when immutable evidence cannot settle behavior.
